svg.title: The crew room, half past six in the morning
svg.desc: A railway depot crew room early in the morning with a long table, nine chairs, a noticeboard with four notices and two people at opposite ends of the table filling in the same form.

g.text: The crew room, half past six in the morning
Fourteen things to find. One of the two people has written a number and stopped.
the noticeboard - four notices, one of them new
Nadia - she wrote the twelve-item list
the only cup on a nine-chair table
the applicant - two years, and he has stopped
Dev, two years on now, at the door
